state.existing: The checked provider owns one Linux V2 client. DISCOVER/six reserved commands/BIND/STOP/STATUS leave initial epoch1 closed and all eight workers parked. Strict legacy full setup denies. Existing full RX native tests inject admission.active=1 and initialize packet ownership directly.
state.proposal: Add a distinct fixed80-byte session-bound cold command envelope. It uses the same provider nonce, loader boot identity and monotonic V2 sequence, not a new attachment session. Validate pinned request address, complete envelope and a private snapshot before native callback. The first implementation supports the post-BIND version query, known port-type setter and checked RX0/RX2 DESC callbacks; other full setup operations remain denied until their contracts are integrated. Native begin derives active=1 from a valid bound initial held epoch with all workers parked, no active transaction/fault/deferred IRQ/release/arm/ready/drain and completed bootstrap. Completion revalidates this state; successful callbacks return the software lease to zero. Ambiguous failure faults and retains the active/inflight state and resources. No reset/recycle/rearm or physical drain flag is introduced. The first authenticated RX0 callback initializes the packet ownership state once from the existing immutable plan; tests no longer inject active or initialize it for this lane.
state.scope: Implement actual Linux/provider and assembled native transport, with native instruction replay. Physical backing/grants/cache/DMA retirement and full later setup/hot/client acceptance remain independent open requirements. This is progress toward full implementation, not completion of the full objective.
state.sequence: The cold codec consumes the same V2 client serial/pending ticket and server last_sequence. An unsupported authenticated command also consumes its sequence, preventing an abandoned request from becoming valid if replayed. Fresh invalid identity/session requests do not gain a callback lease.
